_note: Group-1 FROZEN test set. Written before any prompt/schema fix. NEVER tune prompts, parsers or schema against these tasks. Any change to this file after its commit invalidates results.

tasks.text: I need the transfer characteristic of a SKY130 1.8 V NMOS (NFET). Geometry: width 3 um, length 0.25 um. Temperature is 50 deg C. Hold the drain at 1.0 V and ramp the gate from 0 V to 1.5 V in 25 mV increments. Report the threshold voltage and the peak transconductance. Cap the run at 80 points.

Output characteristics please: NMOS, SKY130 NFET, W=10 um, L=1 um, at 27 C. Gate held at 1.0 V, drain swept 0 to 1.8 V with 37 points. I want the drain current curve and the output conductance. Budget: at most 50 simulation points.

Run a subthreshold study on an NMOS from the SKY130 NFET model. Width 600 nm and length 300 nm, at -20 degrees Celsius. Id-Vg with the drain tied at 0.6 V; gate from 0 to 1.2 V, step 0.03 V. Measure subthreshold swing and the off-current at VGS = 0 V. Use no more than 60 points.

Quick one. SKY130 NFET, NMOS, W = 4 um, L = 0.18 um, room temperature. Id-Vg at VDS = 1.8 V, VGS 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Need on-current at VGS = 1.8 V and threshold voltage. Maximum 40 simulation points. Also, the lab coffee machine is broken again, ignore that.

Characterise the SKY130 NFET (NMOS) with W 8 um, L 0.15 um at 100 degrees C. Do an Id-Vd sweep with VGS fixed at 0.8 V and VDS from 0 to 1.2 V in 0.1 V steps. Measure the drain current only. Allow at most 30 points, a runtime limit of 120 s and 5 tool calls.
SKY130 NFET NMOS, width 2 um, temperature 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS at 1.8 V, gate swept 0 to 1.8 V in steps of 0.05 V. Measure the threshold voltage. At most 50 points.

Can you run a nice simulation of one of those SKY130 devices and tell me if it is any good?
